The Foregone (canon §5c, ruling 111) — the Lawgiver's convergence wearing fur: Blue foresight, the fourth Blue predator, the one that doesn't lie because it has already seen you. The encounter is a foresight duel: the optimal move is the predicted move, and the party wins by feinting, wasting actions, and being deliberately worse. Ledger note: this block is Ben's own spent exception to the ruling-109 Blue moratorium — logged, not precedent.

Near the wrong reaches: Gone Unsure applies — its foresight fails against the wasting-touched (their pattern assumes mortality; theirs has none).

items.name: Forewarned
items.text:
Blue talent, name verbatim.

At the start of each round it silently fixes on one character and one action type (the GM notes it — burrow, bolt-hole, fence-gap). If that character takes the declared action before the surecat's next turn, the surecat gains 1 Reaction — it was already waiting there.

handler.note: Forewarned — silently declare one character + one action type for the coming round (GM note). If it happens: +1 Reaction, and Intercept may fire on it.

events.description: Blue/Foresight. The declaration is GM bookkeeping — the turn-end cue is the prompt; Intercept resolves off the same note.

items.name: Intercept
items.text:
Blue talent, name verbatim (Forewarned's partner).

When the character it declared takes the declared action, spend 1 Focus: that action has disadvantage — you did exactly what it knew you would do.

handler.note: Intercept standing — if the declared character takes the declared action, 1 Focus imposes disadvantage on it.

events.description: Blue/Foresight. The declared-action-taken moment is a table read riding Forewarned's declaration — the turn-end cue keeps the standing order visible.

items.name: Probable Outcome
items.text:
Blue talent, name verbatim, run as GM guidance.

The GM chooses the surecat's fast/slow after seeing the party's choices — it is always acting at the moment it already chose.

items.name: Redirect Momentum
items.text:
Blue talent, name verbatim.

When a character within 30 ft moves, spend 1 Focus and test Blue vs. its Athletics: on a success, reduce its remaining movement by 10 ft or push it 10 ft in any direction — your charge ends where it decided your charge was always going to end.

handler.note: On a success, reduce the mover's remaining movement by 10 ft, or push it 10 ft in any direction (the GM positions the token).

events.description: Blue vs the mover's Athletics, engine-rolled for the foe. 07-24p: the PC talent it copies moved onto its own document, so this ability carries its own rule now instead of riding that talent's deleted engine branch.

handler.note: If the target took the Forewarned-declared action this round: add +1d4 keen — it was already there when they arrived.

events.description: Blue/Foresight. The declared-action rider is a table read (GM holds the declaration) — cue is the floor.

items.name: Gone Unsure
items.text: GM-run wrongness dial (canon §5c): against a wasting-touched creature its Forewarned, Intercept, and pounce rider simply fail — the pattern it reads assumes mortality. Bloodied, it leaves: a predator of certainties does not gamble.

handler.note: Bloodied — it leaves. A predator of certainties does not gamble.

events.description: Blue/Foresight. Bloodied break-off cue.

Brandram.biography:
The Tempered (canon §5c, ruling 112) — the Kenmere spike's Red: heat and ferocity spent one way, the charge. Spike-fed and famine-bold: it is the one THRIVING wild thing on the continent, and it is coming down onto the causeways and ice-roads. Counterplay is the shepherds' rule — deny the run-up: no 20-ft clear line, no charge.

No wasting-eater variant exists (ruling 112 — the spike feeds them); the ruling-34 column does not apply here. ⚑ Momentum's Edge rate is a gate flag: the PC card adds +Speed (+40 on this chassis) — the block ships an adapted +2d4 pending Ben's ruling.

items.name: Reckless Advance
items.text:
Red talent, name verbatim — the authored `use` rule rides (edha-move executor).

Spend 1 Focus: target a creature or objective and charge 10 ft toward it, ignoring Reactions. Halts at walls. The charge begins.

handler.note: Reckless Advance — target a creature/objective, then use: it charges toward it, ignoring Reactions.

events.description: Red/Momentum. Reckless Advance verbatim on the edha-move executor (size by rank ≡ tier).

items.name: Momentum's Edge
items.text:
Red talent, ADAPTED — ⚑ gate flag.

When it Strikes a creature after moving at least 20 ft toward it this turn, the attack deals +2d4 bonus impact. ⚑ ADAPTATION FLAG: the PC card and engine rule add bonus impact equal to Speed — +40 on this chassis, one-shot territory on tier-1 characters. Shipped at +2d4 pending Ben's rate ruling (gate menu: verbatim +40 / half-Speed +20 / dice-scaled +2d4).

events.description: Red/Momentum. Momentum's Edge, rate-adapted: +2d4 impact when it has moved ≥20 ft toward the target this turn (engine-measured via the turn-start stamp). ⚑ PC rule is +Speed — Ben rules the adversary rate at the gate.

items.name: Shockwave Slam
items.text:
Red talent, name verbatim — carries the PC talent's authored `edha-push` rule.

When it hits with a melee attack, the target is pushed up to 10 ft; collision with an obstacle deals half 1d6 impact (half [Tier][Die]: count = tier 1, die = rival rank 2, ruling 122). On an ice-road, the push is the catastrophe.

handler.note: Shockwave Slam

events.description: Red/Momentum. Shockwave Slam verbatim: push by size (role rank, ruling 122), collision half 1d6 impact.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.text:
Red talent, name verbatim — carries the PC talent's authored rule.

When it deals damage on a Fast turn, it moves up to half its Speed without provoking Reactions (once per turn) — it does not stop arriving.

handler.note: Unstoppable — half-Speed move on a Fast-turn damage, ignoring Reactions.

events.description: Red/Momentum. Unstoppable verbatim on the edha-move executor.

items.name: Deny It the Run-Up
items.text: GM-run fight geometry, no trigger: it needs a 20-ft clear line. Denied one — close quarters, broken ground, a doorway — it head-shoves (Ram at 1d6+3, no Momentum's Edge, no Shockwave push beyond 5 ft) and backs away looking for room. The fight is about the floor plan; every fell-village already knows it.

handler.note: Bloodied — it withdraws uphill; it has proved what it came to prove.

events.description: Red/Momentum. Bloodied withdrawal cue (spike-fed: it has no reason to die today).

Tussock-Sow.biography:
The Mirewright (canon §5c, ruling 112 — ruling 80's banked concept, unbanked): Gnothis's Green as craft. She wrights her ground — tussock rows, moats, causeway-humps — and the fight happens inside her workshop. Kit is the banked "Closing Arena" (ruling 106b): Sudden Growth / Spreading Roots / Apex Predator / Drive the Prey.

Blight-gray variant (ruling 34, never tougher): −8 hp, attacks at 5, and she will not break off at bloodied — she is walling her dying litter behind materials that stopped working.

items.name: The Wrighting
items.text:
Green adaptation (ruling 40): Green Leyline Attunement's terrain-on-draw, churned as mire.

When she Draws Mana, a patch of churned mire (difficult terrain, ~10-ft square) opens within Attunement Range — click-to-place. ENGINE-NATIVE VIA Draw Mana: her embedded Green Key click-places the square on each draw.

items.name: Sudden Growth
items.text:
Green talent, name verbatim — carries the PC talent's authored `edha-burst` rule (Sudden Wall precedent).

Mire boils up within 10 ft of a character she can sense — a lane un-made mid-stride.

events.description: Green/Overgrowth. Sudden Growth verbatim: click-place difficult terrain (size/range by rank ≡ tier).

items.name: Spreading Roots
items.text:
Green talent, adapted timing (turn-START — the closed trigger vocabulary; stated on the card, Briar-Gone Grove twin).

When a character starts their turn in her mire, she may spend 1 Focus: the mire churns 10 ft toward them — construction continues.

handler.note: If this character starts its turn in the mire: Spreading Roots (1 Focus) — the mire churns 10 ft toward them (GM extends the terrain).

events.description: Green/Overgrowth. Spreading Roots on the enemy-turn-start cue — timing adapted to the closed trigger vocabulary and stated on the card.

items.name: Apex Predator
items.text:
Green talent, name verbatim.

While three or more enemies are inside her mire, she has advantage on all Physical tests — you are fighting inside her workshop (GM-run state read, no trigger).

items.name: Drive the Prey
items.text:
Green talent, name verbatim (engine contest path rides the name — the Fellstag's Herding Antlers alias, un-aliased).

Spend 2 Focus and test Green vs. Survival against a character within 30 ft: on a success they are Slowed and must move away from her on their next turn — and her ground decides where away leads.

items.name: It Is Construction, Not War
items.text: GM-run register, no trigger: she fights to keep building, not to kill. Leave her ground and stop un-building it and she loses interest. Warden-style craft does NOT work on her — she is animal-smart, not village-minded; the moss-country routes around her instead.

handler.note: Bloodied — she plants herself at the wallow; the fight ends where her ground begins. (Blight-gray variant does not break off.)

events.description: Green/Overgrowth. Bloodied stand-ground cue.

Cragdrake Whelp Pack.biography:
Cragdrake young (canon §5c, ruling 121) — dog-sized, scree-colored, hunting in fours ahead of the adults. The Black side is already awake: whelps orbit whatever is closest to dying. Climb as fast as they run; a wall is not cover.

Minion swarm — add whelps, never hp (ruling-34 column discipline).

items.name: Reckless Advance
items.text:
Red talent, name verbatim — the authored `use` rule rides (edha-move executor).

Spend 1 Focus: target a creature or objective and charge toward it, ignoring Reactions — whelps arrive all at once or not at all.

handler.note: Reckless Advance — target a creature/objective, then use: the whelp charges toward it, ignoring Reactions.

events.description: Red/Momentum. Reckless Advance verbatim on the edha-move executor (size by leyline rank = role rank, ruling 122).

Cragdrake Adult.biography:
The Attendant Red (canon §5c, ruling 121) — wolf-sized pack lizard-kin of the high ranges; Red heat, Black death-sense. They cull the owed: a pack reads a herd and takes the sickest, and shepherds half-bless them for it. The shelves feed them — the going-up works because the drakes finish quick (ruling 121). Famine arc (ruling 24): the murrain means everything reads as dying now; the drakes are coming down.

Count 2 — a hunting pair is one rival-weight encounter; add whelps, never hp. Ben's kit ruling: rival = wolf-sized, carries Searing Bolt.

items.name: Searing Bolt
items.text:
Red talent, name verbatim — native attack/damage automation; [Tier][Die] resolved 1d6: dice count = tier 1, die = rival leyline rank 2 (ruling 122).

A spat lance of furnace-heat — the trick that earns the folk name “dragon.”

items.name: Predatory Patience
items.text:
Black talent — carries the PC talent's authored rule shape verbatim (the name alone is NOT engine-keyed — Kettavar 4c audit sweep).

When it attacks a Weakened creature, add 1d6 to the test; on a successful attack against a Weakened creature it regains 1 Focus — it has been reading the herd for days.

events.description: Carries the PC Predatory Patience test rider verbatim; 1d6 = 1d(2·rank+2) at rival leyline rank 2 (ruling 122).

handler.note: If the target is Weakened: the drake regains 1 Focus (GM adds — adversary focus has no auto-write).

events.description: GM cue on a landed hit — the Focus-regain half of Predatory Patience, cue as the floor.

items.name: Explosive Leap
items.text:
Red talent, name verbatim — free maneuver (PC cost ◇); the `use` rule rides the edha-move executor; the landing test is table-adjudicated on the card.

Leap up to 20 ft without provoking Reactions. Creatures within 5 ft of where it lands test Physical or fall Prone — scree jumps down onto the path.

handler.note: Explosive Leap — move without provoking; on landing, creatures within 5 ft test Physical or fall Prone (GM adjudicates the test).

events.description: Red/Momentum. Explosive Leap on the edha-move executor; landing prone-test stays on the card (activated, not a silent trigger).

Cragdrake Alpha.biography:
The pack's horse-scale matriarch (canon §5c, ruling 121) — two trees deep, as bosses run (ruling 39). She holds the high routes between the steadings and the quiet shelves, and the pack does not fight where she has not chosen the ground. Boss leyline rank 3: her dice run d8, two per formula at tier 2 (ruling 122).

Ben's kit ruling: the boss carries the AoE (Flame Surge — the breath). First bestiary reuse of the W29-widened Dread Presence veto after the Dirgehound.

items.name: Flame Surge
items.text:
Red talent, name verbatim — AoE, GM-rolled on the card (activated, no hidden trigger); [Tier][Die] resolved 2d8: dice count = tier 2, die = boss leyline rank 3 (ruling 122).

The breath: each character within 10 ft of a point within 60 ft tests Athletics vs. Red. On a failure they take 2d8 energy damage, and half as much on a success.

items.name: Dread Presence
items.text:
Black talent, name verbatim — the engine's preUpdateToken veto rides the name (ruling 113 owner-scan).

Weakened characters within 60 ft (Attunement Range at boss rank 3 — parity fix, Kettavar 4c audit) cannot willingly move closer to any allies — the herd-cut, worked on people.

items.name: Predator's Due
items.text:
Black talent — carries the PC talent's authored rule shape verbatim (Dirgehound precedent).

When it reduces a character to 0 health, it regains 2d8 health and 1 Focus — the owed, collected.

handler.note: Predator's Due: +2d8 health ([Tier][Die]: count = tier 2, die = boss rank 3, ruling 122) and 1 Focus on the kill (focus is a GM add).

events.description: Black/Ritual. On reducing a character to 0 HP: regain 2d8 health (engine-applied; ruling 122 dice) + 1 Focus (GM adds).

items.name: Unstoppable
items.text:
Red talent, name verbatim — carries the PC talent's authored rule.

When it deals damage on a Fast turn, it moves up to half its Speed without provoking Reactions (once per turn) — she does not stop arriving.

handler.note: Unstoppable — half-Speed move on a Fast-turn damage, ignoring Reactions.

events.description: Red/Momentum. Unstoppable verbatim on the edha-move executor.

items.text: GM-run pack doctrine, no trigger: she opens on whoever the Black reads weakest (Weakened, Prone, bloodied) and breaks off rather than trade blows with a healthy line.

handler.note: Bloodied — the pack disengages and circles for the high ground; drakes cull, they don't duel.

events.description: Bloodied withdrawal cue — the counterplay is making the cull cost more than it feeds.

Bellwether.biography:
The White lead-ewe (canon §5c, ruling 121) — the continent's first domesticated attuned lineage: the flock moves as one body behind her, worth three dogs and priced like a horse. An encounter PIECE, not a monster: protect her, steal her, or watch a murrain-stuck flock stop following (“the bell goes unanswered”).

⚑ art wishlist — no fitting core icon; placeholder is deliberate.

items.text:
White talent, name verbatim (engine name-keyed where applicable).

Spend 1 Focus to designate a creature within 30 ft. The next ally who tests against it this round raises the stakes — the flock's hundred eyes point one way.

items.name: Ordered Advance
items.text:
White talent, name verbatim (rules on this item since 07-25).

Spend 1 Focus. This round, when she moves, flock-followers (and allies) within 10 ft may move half their Speed without provoking Reactions — the flock crosses the scree as one animal.

events.description: edha-move-window (07-25, pass 2bR — was riding the talent's retired name-keyed hook): use arms the round window; each move posts the allies-within-10ft half-Speed card.

Hazewyrm Whelp Pack.biography:
Hazewyrm young (canon §5c, ruling 137) — dog-sized, dust-colored, hunting in threes in the shimmer ahead of an adult. They already run hot: the bite scalds, and what the heat has touched cannot hide from them. The Blue self-veil is not awake yet — the whelps are simply hard to see in the glare.

Minion swarm — add whelps, never hp (ruling-34 column discipline). Leylines red/blue; minion role rank 1.

items.text:
Red talent, name verbatim (engine name-keyed).

Its energy damage deals +1 additional damage (the Red-modifier term = +rank, minion leyline rank 1, ruling 122). A creature it deals energy damage to sheds light in 5 ft and loses concealment until the end of its next turn — the glare finds it.

handler.note: Kindle: +1 energy (Red modifier = +rank, minion rank 1, ruling 122). lightRadiusFt 5 fires the concealment-strip/light path (edhaLightSpecFor) on the energy hit.

events.description: Carries Kindle's damage-rider shape verbatim; Red-modifier = +rank = +1 at minion role rank (ruling 122); lightRadiusFt 5 wires the light/concealment clause the card promises.

Hazewyrm Adult.biography:
The Veiled Red (canon §5c, ruling 137) — a solitary Red/Blue ambusher of the mesas, the cousin of Vorsk's pack-running cragdrake. Where the cragdrake attends a herd, the hazewyrm hunts wrapped in its own heat-shimmer: the air above it boils until its outline swims, and the first you know of it is the strike. Densest in the dead interior near the god (ruling 128 — the ecology tell).

The encounter is locate-before-it-burns, not a stat slug. Rival leyline rank 2; carries Searing Bolt. The Held Haze writes the ambush ledger the Bite's rider reads.

items.text:

The first time it strikes each creature per scene, that creature has tested Perception against its Cognitive defense (engine-rolled): on a failure it could not fix the wyrm's position, and the strike comes from the shimmer.

handler.note: The whenTargetFooled rider on its Bite applies vs the fooled — the strike from the heat-haze.

handler.note: Red/Conflagration. After it deals energy damage, spend an Opportunity to leave the target Afflicted [half 1d6 energy] ongoing — heatstroke. Opportunity trusted (no auto-deduct). Target the creature, then accept the prompt.

Hazewyrm Elder.biography:
The mesa's oldest Veiled Red (canon §5c, ruling 137) — two trees deep, as bosses run (ruling 39). It holds the dead interior nearest the god, where the Red/Blue runs thickest; the deeper you track it, the closer you are to Razkael (ruling 128, the wear-compass in the ecology). Boss leyline rank 3: its dice run d8, two per formula at tier 2 (ruling 122).

Around it the heat throws false selves — a strike may find nothing but boiling air — but that is the table's read to adjudicate, not a die.

Second tier-2 boss precedent after the Cragdrake Alpha (ruling 123) — chassis in the tier-1 boss hp band, tier carries the load through dice count. Carries the AoE (Flame Surge — the breath) and Searing Bolt (the reach, giving Kindle a live energy attack).

events.description: +1d8 when the target is taken in by The Held Haze; [Die] at boss rank 3 = d8 (ruling 122).

The breath, loosed through the haze: each character within 10 ft of a point within 60 ft tests Athletics vs. Red. On a failure they take 2d8 energy damage, and half as much on a success.

The Reckoning.biography:
The Ordered March (canon §5c, ruling 137) — desert coursers that hunt the caravan roads not by speed but by flawless coordination: they cut the line, drive the straggler onto open ground, and close as one mind. This is why the Water-Peace and the way-witness exist (ruling 134) — the road is theirs after dark. Ruling 36/111's White country is one continuous ground: the same White as Canticle's herd-rim, across the Kaelmere border.

Rival, pack-run (count 3 = one rival-weight encounter; the block is the pack with its lead-beast). The danger is coordination — break the lead-beast and the pack loses its line. Distinct from the callthief's White influence trick.

items.name: Guiding Signal
items.text:
White talent, name verbatim (engine name-keyed where applicable).

Spend 1 Focus — the lead-beast picks the straggler: designate a creature within 30 ft. The next ally who tests against it this round raises the stakes.

items.text:
White talent, name verbatim (rules on this item since 07-25).

Spend 1 Focus. This round, when the lead-beast moves, pack-followers within 10 ft may move half their Speed without provoking Reactions — the pack crosses the flat as one animal.

events.description: edha-move-window (07-25, pass 2bR — was riding the talent's retired name-keyed hook): use arms the round window; each move posts the allies-within-10ft half-Speed card.

items.name: Unbreakable Line
items.text:
White talent, name verbatim — the DC test is engine-cued at the drop and adjudicated at the table (adversary Investiture has no auto-write).

Once per round, when a pack-mate adjacent to the lead would drop to 0 health, the lead may test White (DC = half the damage taken) to hold it at 1 instead — the line does not break.

handler.note: A pack-mate dropped within 5 ft: the lead may test White (DC = half the damage) via the contest core to hold it at 1 health; once per round.

events.description: GM cue on a same-side drop within 5 ft (ally-drops hook) — Unbreakable Line's hold, cued at the named hook; the DC test runs through the contest core.

items.text: NO NAMEABLE HOOK: which prey the pack cuts from the line is NPC intent and targeting, not module data (Pack Tactics class). They do not outrun you — they out-organize you. Counterplay is denying them the cut: stay in the line, and break the lead-beast.

The Slagbull.biography:
The Kiln (canon §5c, ruling 137) — a big-bodied Red charger of the mesa flats, territorial and running hot, most active in the killing noon when everything else shelters. The honest Red bruiser under the apex; not subtle, but the wall behind you is its ally.

Rival leyline rank 2. Kit swaps from the §5c concept note, surfaced at this gate: Momentum's Edge (bonus impact = Speed) scales absurdly as a statblock literal, and Breaking Point's 'second damage in a round' trigger has no adversary hook — replaced by Reckless Advance (the charge) and Unstoppable (it keeps arriving), both proven wiring; Shockwave Slam kept.

items.text:
Red talent, name verbatim — carries the PC on-hit push rule; wall-collision [Tier][Die] resolved half 1d6: count = tier 1, die = rival leyline rank 2 (ruling 122).

When it hits with a melee (impact) attack, it pushes the target up to its Size in feet; a collision with an obstacle deals half 1d6 impact — the hit lands, the wall finishes it.

handler.note: Shockwave Slam — push [Size] ft on a melee impact hit; wall collision half 1d6 (ruling 122 dice).

Spend 1 Focus: pick a creature or objective and charge toward it, ignoring Reactions.

The Doubled.biography:
The fetch (canon §5c, ruling 147) — the Black/Blue pair apex of the Kettavar tundra, the folk name the campaign's GM label borrows. A long-limbed white stalker that hunts the whiteout: its Black half reads what is weakening, its Blue half wears the shape of the familiar — a herder you know, a tent at the right distance, your own dog. It takes the stragglers the cullwolves won't.

The encounter is trust-horror, not a stat slug: the Doubling writes the ambush ledger the Grasp's rider reads. Solitary — add cullwolves for a mixed scene, never a second fetch (two fetches is the Elder's story). Rival leyline rank 2 (ruling 122).

The Doubled Elder.biography:
The old fetch (canon §5c, ruling 147) — densest-attunement class, the beasts that grew stronger as the faith fed (the Kettavar inversion). It has worn more shapes than the parish has people, and the dogs stopped being able to tell decades ago.

Boss tier 2 in the tier-1 hp band (the Cragdrake-Alpha/Hazewyrm-Elder precedent, ruling 123): the chassis stays killable, tier carries the load through dice count. The boss fight is the trust-horror made mechanical: The Seeming stands a second copy of whatever it currently wears — which of the two walked out of the white?

items.name: Raking Grasp
items.rider: +1d8 against a creature taken in by The Doubling or The Seeming.

events.description: +1d8 (flavor-labeled) vs the fooled; [Die] at boss rank 3 = d8 (ruling 122).

Cullwolf Pack.biography:
The Tithe (canon §5c, ruling 147) — death-sense wolves of the tundra that take exactly the failing animal, never a sound one. Herders let them work: the cull takes what would have sickened the herd. Distinct from the Dirgehound Pack by design: the dirgehound CREATES isolation (Unnerving Approach); the cullwolf PUNISHES what is already failing — Severance, its first bestiary carrier.

Famine-arc variant (the cull that cannot close, ruling 147): off Kettavar's steered routes, run them starving — they attack the merely alive. Scaling: add wolves, never hp. Minion leyline rank 1 (ruling 122).

The pack's elder (canon §5c, ruling 147) — the one that decides what is failing. It has watched herds longer than most herders have.

Runs with a Cullwolf Pack; the alpha takes the kill (Predator's Due). Rival leyline rank 2 (ruling 122).

Black talent — carries the PC talent's authored rule shape verbatim (the test-rider + on-hit cue below; the name alone is NOT engine-keyed).

When it attacks a Weakened creature, add 1d6 to the test; on a successful attack against a Weakened creature it regains 1 Focus — it took the failing one on purpose.

events.description: Carries the PC Predatory Patience test rider verbatim; 1d6 = 1d(2·rank+2) at rival leyline rank (ruling 122). Target the creature first.

handler.note: If the target is Weakened: it regains 1 Focus (GM adds — adversary focus has no auto-write).

events.description: GM cue on a landed hit — the Focus regain half of Predatory Patience, cue as the floor.

items.name: Predator's Due
items.text:
Black talent — carries the PC talent's authored rule shape verbatim (the Dirgehound precedent).

When it reduces a character to 0 health, it regains 1d6 health and 1 Focus — the cull closes, and it feeds.

handler.note: Predator's Due: +1d6 health ([Tier][Die]: count = tier 1, die = rival rank 2, ruling 122) and 1 Focus on the kill (focus is a GM add).

events.description: Black/Ritual. On reducing a character to 0 HP: regain 1d6 health (engine-applied; ruling 122 dice) + 1 Focus (GM adds).

items.name: Waits for the Failing
items.text: GM-run: bloodied (≤ half HP), the alpha calls the pack off to the ridge line — they do not press sound prey; they wait.

handler.note: Bloodied — the alpha withdraws the pack to watching distance; they shadow, they do not press.

events.description: GM morale cue at half HP.
